description: Segments du Domaine Public Fluvial (DPF) - Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Office Français de la Biodiversité (OFB) - Information Géographique sur l'Eau. Un Elément du Domaine Public Fluvial est soit une partie de Cours d'Eau, soit un Plan d'Eau, soit un Ouvrage appartenant au domaine public fluvial. Coverage: Office Français de la Biodiversité (OFB) - Information Géographique sur l'Eau. The publisher named on the listing is Office Français de la Biodiversité (OFB) - Information Géographique sur l'Eau. Its keywords include observation-de-la-terre-et-environnement, domaine-public-fluvial, zonage, france, segment-hydrographique-thematique, hvd. The listing shows 5 download or service links in FILE:GEO, OGC:WMS, 0-HTTP--LINK, OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
